model: The RF corner is copied from ST's NUCLEO-WB55 (MB1355 rev D-01): a 0.6 mm L1 line with 0.2 mm gaps to the L1 ground, and L2 cut out under it, so the line references L3. This script computes that line on MB1355's stack-up and on JLC04161H-7628, and what it would be with L2 kept (why ST cuts it). It also keeps the 50 ohm width table for a line referenced to L2.

stack.name: JLC04161H-7628 L1 over L2
stack.source: JLCPCB stack-up JLC04161H-7628: 7628 prepreg 0.2104 mm, Dk 4.4; 1 oz outer copper (D-008)

l2_reference_50_ohm.corners: width +/-0.03 mm, gap -/+0.03 mm, h -/+10 %, er +/-5 % (ASSUMPTION fab tolerances)

geometry.source: scripts/pcb/mb1355_rf.json (MB1355 D-01 RF tracks, L1 pour gap)

stack.name: MB1355 L1 over L3 (L2 cut out)
stack.source: MB1355.PcbDoc layer stack: L1 1.6 mil / 18 mil FR-4 Dk 4.2 / L2 1.2 mil / 20 mil Dk 4.4 / L3

stack.name: JLC04161H-7628 L1 over L3 (L2 cut out)
